title: Coherent coefficient sections giving the derived scalar-extension unit decomposition
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate field E of its algebraic closure Omega, using the coefficient model of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category] and the actual scalar actions of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-derived-scalar-basis-pushforward]. There exist a common index type I and sections b(Z,i):1 -> Omega_Z for every scheme Z. For every morphism f:X -> Y they satisfy b(X,i)=epsilon_f followed by f^* b(Y,i) and the canonical coefficient comparison. For every derived E_Z-module M and every chosen I-copower of M, the extension unit followed by restriction of the explicitly descended multiplication by b(Z,i) exhibits its restriction of derived extension as that copower. No direct-image conclusion is assumed.

source.place: finiteFreePushData, continuousBasisSheafIso and isIso_leftDerivedBasisUnitDesc for the finite-basis template; the finite-subextension-valued section model of WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/RingObjects/Condensed/FiniteSubextension.lean supplies the finite-support extension described in the original scalar-basis proof.

proof.text: Choose the common coherent coefficient sections, ordinary module copower, and exact extension from [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-derived-scalar-basis-sections]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-derived-scalar-basis-unit-of-sections] to the ordinary scalar-unit maps, obtaining the derived copower for every object. Retain the original section-coherence conjunct unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_condensedQbar_scalar_basis_unit :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1))
      (b : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, I →
        (𝟙_ (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) ⟶
          condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) Z)),
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : I), b X i =
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (f)^*[Ab.{u + 1}] ≫
          (f)^*[Ab.{u + 1}].map (b Y i) ≫
            condensedPullbackHom (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) f) ∧
      (∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Z)))
        [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ M)],
        IsIso (Sigma.desc (f := fun _ : I ↦ M) fun i ↦
          Mod.qbar_scalarUnitLeg (coefficientMap
            (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z) (b Z i) M))
